title: Generator Library Growth Pipeline
purpose: Data-only seed registry that defines how LLMGameCreator may safely propose, generate, validate, stage, approve and activate new generator-library modules, atlas records and artifact contracts without treating LLM output as trusted code.
principles: Capability gaps are described before files are generated.
A proposed module starts as a staged library growth proposal, not as an active runtime feature.
LLM may draft specs, prompts, docs, manifests, examples and deterministic Lua modules, but C# validators own promotion gates.
Generated Lua remains restricted: no io, os, debug, package, load, loadfile, dofile, network or filesystem access.
New capabilities, artifact contracts and runtime targets require human approval before they influence planning or export.
Small data/doc changes may be committed directly after shape and reference checks; executable Lua or C# changes require stronger gates.
Adult/NSFW support is modeled as optional tagged content overlays and artifact metadata, not as hidden behavior inside a module.
Library growth should prefer extending atlas/contracts/validators before adding custom C# integration.

proposal_kinds.title: Capability Gap
proposal_kinds.purpose: A missing capability, feature bundle, runtime target, validator or artifact contract discovered during game profile planning.

proposal_kinds.title: Atlas Data Patch
proposal_kinds.purpose: A data-only addition or correction to capability atlas, reference profiles, validation pipeline or artifact contract registry.

proposal_kinds.title: Lua Generator Module
proposal_kinds.purpose: A restricted deterministic Lua module that produces a named artifact contract or IR output.

proposal_kinds.title: Validator Rule
proposal_kinds.purpose: A deterministic validation rule or validation-level mapping for a known artifact contract.

proposal_kinds.title: Artifact Contract
proposal_kinds.purpose: A new data-only contract that future generators may produce and validators/exporters may consume.

proposal_kinds.title: Unity IR Adapter
proposal_kinds.purpose: A Unity-facing adapter plan or IR shape that maps compiled game data to Unity runtime shell features.

strict_generation_prompt_requirements: State target file paths exactly and forbid extra root-level files.
State the artifact contract produced by every generator or data file.
State canonical manifest fields and prohibit historical aliases.
For Lua modules, require manifest, validate_config(config), generate(input, ctx), deterministic output and JSON-serializable data only.
For generated data, require exact ids/enums copied from input and forbid hidden activation of optional content overlays.
For adult/NSFW-aware additions, require explicit content tags, overlay ids and export/platform filter metadata, while keeping mechanics functional without the overlay.
Require diagnostics instead of thrown errors for normal validation failures.
Require examples and minimal docs for every non-trivial module or contract.

activation_rules.notes: Small data/doc seeds may be committed without Codex when paths and JSON are valid.
Lua modules are not active just because files exist. They become active after manifest import/integrity checks and approval.
New contracts affect future generators, validators and exporters.
Unity adapters must remain IR/export-bound, not arbitrary generated source execution.

model_roles.title: Designer / lore / architecture model
model_roles.typical_model: Gemma 4 26B A4B Instruct Ultra Uncensored Heretic or stronger

model_roles.title: Batch generator model
model_roles.typical_model: Gemma 4 E4B Instruct Ultra Uncensored Heretic or similar small fast model

non_goals: Do not make every new idea require C# and Unity work immediately.
Do not let generated Lua become unrestricted runtime code.
Do not treat a generated file as active just because it compiles or parses.
Do not require manual review for every low-risk generated item; use validation, repair loops and sampling.
Do not hard-code adult/NSFW behavior into core mechanics; keep it as explicit optional overlay metadata.
